subject: Actogram / Daily graph start and end time and Table of data.

messages.author: 534a07b78723166d
messages.subject: Actogram / Daily graph start and end time and Table of data.
parts:
Hello, is it possible to have the actogram go from noon to noon rather than midnight to midnight ? See image attached for reference. 

Also, is it possible to add a table with all the data in it ? For example, sleep onset time, rise time, total time in bed, total sleep time, total wake time, sleep efficiency? I know all this is seen in the graphs / charts. I'd like to see it in a table.

messages.author: 4b9dc262ec278dc5
messages.subject: Re: Actogram / Daily graph start and end time and Table of data.
parts:
Hi,

To set the window from noon to noon in the visual report, you can use the parameter viewingwindow: https://wadpac.github.io/GGIR/articles/GGIRParameters.html#:~:text=combination%20of%20them.-,viewingwindow,-Numeric%20(default%20%3D%201

For your other question, the visualreport as it is right now in GGIR is not customizable, it always comes with the barplots on the first page and the signal time series on the following pages.

Best,
Jairo
